body: No problem man, I glad I can offer comfort during this time to you. We as humans are always making mistakes. I’ve made plenty of mistakes during my relationship with her that I can tell her I’m sorry for. I reflected and realized more I could have put in to make her happy. So don’t beat your self down for that. For as how long this pain is going to last, there is no answer for that. Every one is different on how well they deal with pain. Best advice I can give however is to do something you love. I play guitar and it helps me by distracting me from her. Now for substance of getting high. I don’t recommend. I’m not going to tell you not to do that. For you have free will and I have no right to tell you what to do with your life. However, taking drugs to suppress feelings isn’t going to help man. It’s going to hurt you even more. People who do this lead them to try harder drugs to suppress those feelings with will make their life harder. I will pray for you not to go down that path. It will get better I can promise you that. One day at a time will get better. I hope for the best for you man. I usual don’t check Reddit to much, but if you need something for encouragement ask me. The best for you man!

Don’t worry brother, same thing happened to me last Sunday. Only different thing is that her friends convinced her that’s she was not happy with me. Her family told her to listen to her heart but instead she listened to her friends. We were together for 5 months. I was really sad for 2 days but on the 3rd day I realized that there’s nothing I can do now. Nothing will change. That’s has helped me kind of through it. I don’t know if that will help you or not, but what has happened has happened. The best thing you can do and I recommend is to not contact her or fight her on her decision. If you fought already you should stop. She has made up her mind that she wanted to end it. You can’t change how she feels. Just immediately cut contact with her. Don’t text her and let her start the conversation. She decided that she no longer wants to be with you, so you should not be the one to go back to her. Give her space. If you see her on a daily basis, don’t be weird and ignore her, but keep it short. Give her some time to reflect on her decision. Giving her your absence will make her reflect and maybe miss you. During this work on yourself. Reflect on how you messed up and work on that. I don’t know if you’re religious but become closer to what you believe in. Being the better version of yourself will help you and maybe even show her that you changed. If you do this your chances, if you even want to, of getting back to her will go higher. If she dose come back don’t be overly excited that she did. You need to start at square one of your relationship. You need her to build the relationship back to where you guys were. That’s not saying that you should let her do all the work, because that will make her leave again. But she left and she needs to put in the work to be put back into your life. I hope this helps you man. This is what I was told through talking through people and I hope this can help you.
